description: rank_search_matches over the candidate pool returned by record-search-martin-betty-christening-hit — the 1812 Bitton, Gloucestershire christening of Betty Martin, daughter of Thomas and Sophia. Scored against tree person I1 (Elizabeth Martin, the subject). Exists because search-records Step 4 ranks the pool before triaging it, and rank_search_matches is NOT in mock_mcp.LIVE_TOOLS: with no fixture declaring it the tool is never registered, and the call aborts the run Type 1 (unmatched_tool_call, exit 2, corpus issue) instead of being graded. Predicate is a bare substring match on subjectId so it fires whichever subject handle the skill passes. matchScore is high because the christening's place and 1812 date sit inside the plan item's 1808-1815 Gloucestershire window; attachedToSubject is false because the record is undiscovered — that is the whole premise of the test.
